classification.difficultyReason: Select readable points on the supplied line, distinguish the line from scattered observations, calculate its gradient and combine it with the intercept to form an equation.

content.prompt:
A teacher is interested in the relationship between the number of hours a student spends revising and their mark in a test.

The diagram shows the dataset used in the investigation and the least-squares regression line.

What is the equation of the least-squares regression line relating to the dataset?

spec.description: Five black circular markers and a dashed regression line; solid major grid and dotted intermediate horizontal grid, in the same style as p37-q13.
spec.mathematics: x from 0 to 10, ticks every 1; y from 0 to 40, labelled ticks every 4 and dotted intermediate lines every 2. Points (1,12), (3,16), (4,20), (7,28), (9,36). Dashed line y=3x+8, clipped at y=40. The line is the exact least-squares line of these points.
spec.answerVisibility: The dataset and dashed line are permanent givens. No equation label is printed.

answer.worked:
The line crosses the $y$-axis at 8. Two points on the line are $(0,8)$ and $(4,20)$.
$$\begin{aligned}m&=\frac{20-8}{4-0}\\&=3\\y&=3x+8\end{aligned}$$
